scope: Remote dynamic Markdown text/code/table projection and native interactions
implementation: Packaged iOS293 JS parser plus existing independent native text/code/table views. Native OAIMarkdown equivalence remains unproven.
r1_diagnosis: Rich tests used an incorrect table-cell identifier containing -cell-. Actual native identifier omits that segment. Corrected the selector and reran both languages successfully. Product code was unchanged between rounds.

preview.surface: Chinese completed Remote rich response with keyboard open
preview.manual_input: PreviewMarkdown confirmed through the native Pinyin keyboard, then submitted through ordinary send

limits: Native block spacing and 180pt table column widths are existing independent host geometry.
Block IDs use parser positions; arbitrary insertion before a block can change identity.
Only one offline account exists; multi-account isolation is unimplemented. Earlier v550 account-scope wording corrected.
Link action exposes URL and a returnable pending-browser status; browser integration remains pending.
Copyable text currently equals synthetic source; original copyableMarkdown transformations unresolved.
Dynamic reasoning, tool/file-diff events and full semantic content pipeline remain pending.
Exact character selection through arbitrary revision/reflow and process restart recovery remain pending.
next: Close dynamic tool/reasoning/error message projection and same-page interactions, then test mixed-content updates with reading recovery.
